half_elf.name: Half Elf
half_elf.size: Half-elves are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
half_elf.speed: Half-elves have a base speed of 30 feet.

deep_one_hybrid.name: Deep One Hybrid
deep_one_hybrid.size: Deep One Hybrids are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
deep_one_hybrid.speed: A deep one hybrid’s base speed is 20 feet, as it walks with a shuffling gait. A deep one hybrid has a swim speed of 30 feet, and gains a +8 racial bonus on all Swim checks.

drider.name: Drider
drider.speed: Normal (0 RP); +10 ft. due to extra legs (see below)

ganzi.name: Ganzi
ganzi.size: Ganzis are Medium creatures and have no bonuses of penalties due to their size.
ganzi.speed: Ganzis have a base speed of 30 feet.

gathlain.name: Gathlain
gathlain.size: Gathlains are Small and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls , a –1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to CMD , a +2 bonus on Fly checks, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
gathlain.speed: Gathlains have a base speed of 30 feet and a fly speed of 40 feet (poor maneuverability).

gillmen.name: Gillmen
gillmen.size: Gillmen are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
gillmen.speed: Gillmen have a base speed of 30 feet on land. As aquatic creatures, they also have a swim speed of 30 feet, can move in water without making Swim checks, and always treat Swim as a class skill.

kasatha.speed: Kasathas have a base speed of 30 feet. (0 RP)

save_items.name: Boots of the Cat
save_items.description: Soft gray leather boots that grant a +2 bonus on Acrobatics and Reflex saving throws against trip or falling hazards.

save_items.name: Boots of Friendly Terrain

save_items.name: Cap of the Free Thinker

save_items.name: Amulet of the Planes

save_items.name: Bracers of Steadfast Resilience

save_items.name: Band of the Stalwart Warrior
save_items.description: Grants a +2 morale bonus on Fortitude saving throws against fatigue, exhaustion, and despair.

save_items.name: Brooch of Shielding
save_items.description: Fastens a cloak and absorbs magical force, granting a +1 bonus on saving throws against harmful spells.

save_items.name: Medallion of Courage
save_items.description: A shining gold medallion that confers a +2 morale bonus on Will saving throws against fear and despair.

save_items.name: All-Tool (Alchemical)
save_items.description: An alchemically treated item aiding in bodily and magical resistance (+1 all saves).
